an1.1:0.1: suttantapiṭake aṅguttaranikāyassa paṭhamo bhāgo ekanipāto namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an1.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an1.1:2.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarūpaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthirūpaṃ
an1.1:2.2: itthirūpaṃ bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.2:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaddaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthisaddo
an1.2:1.2: itthisaddo bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.3:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekagandhaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthigandho
an1.3:1.2: itthigandho bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.4:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarasaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthiraso
an1.4:1.2: itthiraso bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.5:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekaphoṭṭhabbaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthiphoṭṭhabbo
an1.5:1.2: itthiphoṭṭhabbo bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.6:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarūpaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave purisarūpaṃ
an1.6:1.2: purisarūpaṃ bhikkhave itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.7:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaddaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave purisasaddo
an1.7:1.2: purisasaddo bhikkhave itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.8:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekagandhaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave purisagandho
an1.8:1.2: purisagandho bhikkhave itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.9:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarasaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave purisaraso
an1.9:1.2: purisaraso bhikkhave itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
an1.10:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekaphoṭṭhabbaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave purisaphoṭṭhabbo
an1.10:1.2: purisaphoṭṭhabbo bhikkhave itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.
